# claude-support-identity-verification
- **URL:** https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14328960-identity-verification-on-claude · **Accessed:** 2026-09-16 · **For:** v1 response round, Findings A and D (what verification collects; triggers)
- **What it establishes:** Anthropic's help-center page. Verification may be requested "when accessing certain capabilities, as part of our routine platform integrity checks, or other safety and compliance measures" (appeals, age assurance, cyber safeguards). Requires "a valid government-issued photo ID: the physical document, in hand" and potentially "a live selfie with your phone." Vendor is Persona Identities; Anthropic says it does not copy or store ID images and does not train on identity data. No nationality or citizenship language; no tier list.
- **Key passages:**
  - "when accessing certain capabilities, as part of our routine platform integrity checks, or other safety and compliance measures"
  - "We selected Persona Identities as our verification partner based on the strength of their technology, privacy controls, and security safeguards."
  - "We are not using your identity data to train our models. Verification data is used solely to confirm who you are."
- **Reliability:** Primary (company policy page; undated, may have been revised since July).
- **Relevance to this project:** Shows verification is a standing, trigger-based mechanism ("certain capabilities") rather than a one-off tied to the directive; also the identity gate the Cyber Verification Program relies on.
- **Slice L addendum (re-opened 2026-09-16, v2→v3 response round):** Page re-read in full (page dated "August 11, 2026"). Persona is named ("We selected Persona Identities as our verification partner"). Contestability passages, verbatim: "**Try again.** You'll have multiple attempts within the verification flow—most failures are resolved by retaking the photo in better lighting, removing or using a different government-issued photo ID." / "**Contact us.** If you've used your attempts and still can't verify, reach out to us via this help form and we'll take a look." / "Anthropic can access verification records through Persona’s platform when needed—for example, to review an appeal—but we don't copy or store those images ourselves." / a separate appeal form exists for accounts banned after verification ("If you feel your account has been wrongly banned, please fill out the appeal form ... so our Safeguards team can further investigate"). Scope sentence: "We are rolling out identity and business verification for a few use cases, and you might see a verification prompt when accessing certain capabilities, as part of our routine platform integrity checks, or other safety and compliance measures." The page nowhere says ordinary use of Claude requires ID; it also does not promise it never will. Opening line worth quoting: "Being responsible with powerful technology starts with knowing who is using it." Sharing carve-out: "except where legally required to respond to valid legal processes."
